draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.14, the 104th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 7th of 10 at QB. He went 67th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (104th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Jarrett Stidham. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,508 passing yards in 2020, 9th of 10 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Houston Texans. 44 career games and 29 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 7 in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 2 (6th percentile), completion % 57.2% (9th percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 quarterback who played: 915 passing yards against a median of 1,226, below the norm.
